channel.title: LC Insight
channel.description: Read the chain, not the rumors. Crypto market news and on-chain analysis.

item.title: Rain (RAIN) jumped 43% in about an hour overnight, and it is still 74% below its August record
item.description: RAIN climbed from about $0.0036 to $0.0052 between 12:50 and 1:55 a.m. ET on thin trading, with BingX carrying more than half of the day's volume.

item.title: Solana ETFs lost $136.7 million in four weeks with only one inflow day
item.description: U.S. spot Solana funds saw money leave on 14 of 20 trading days from October 19 to November 13, CoinMarketCap data show. XRP funds lost $19.1 million last week.

item.title: Jito's staked SOL shrank by 289,349 tokens in a month as its price fell 31%
item.description: JitoSOL, Jito's liquid staking token on Solana, ended Sunday at 7.87 million tokens, CoinMarketCap data show. Supply fell on most days of the selloff.

item.title: Kelp's rsETH lost 10% of its supply in a month. Rocket Pool's rETH fell 3.6%
item.description: About 37,900 rsETH tokens were redeemed or burned between October 15 and November 15, CoinMarketCap data show, as ether fell a quarter. Ether.fi's weETH held steady.

item.title: Lido's stETH grew by 87,688 ETH in a month as ether fell 25%
item.description: Holders kept staking through the selloff. Lido's staked ether token reached 9.75 million on Sunday, CoinMarketCap data show, with more than half of the month's growth in the last week.

item.title: Coinbase's cbBTC added 7,185 bitcoin in a week as bitcoin fell 13%, closing in on WBTC
item.description: The supply of Coinbase's wrapped bitcoin token rose to 102,692 by Sunday evening, CoinMarketCap data show. That is about $468 million of new tokens in seven days, and it is closing in on WBTC.

item.title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin's '3-month low' was its lowest since July. 5 weekend claims checked
item.description: Weekend headlines said bitcoin broke $64,000, hit a three-month low and XRP sank to its lowest since 2024. We checked five of them against CoinGecko's price records. Three hold up, one is only partly checked, one cannot be checked.

item.title: Bitcoin sat flat at $64,749 on Sunday after a 13% weekly drop, and Zcash lost 28%
item.description: Bitcoin moved just 0.1% in 24 hours as the crash paused. The seven-day damage stayed deep across the top coins, with Zcash, Uniswap and Pepe down a quarter or more. Quant led the small Sunday bounce.

item.title: Solana Mobile's SKR jumped 41% in 10 hours, and Korea's Upbit did half the trading
item.description: Seeker, the token tied to Solana Mobile, rose from under 1 cent to $0.0122 on Sunday night as daily trading roughly quadrupled. Korean won markets on Upbit and Bithumb carried most of it.

item.title: EVAA is up 142% in two days, and $60 million traded in a token worth $18 million
item.description: The lending token on TON and BNB Chain climbed from $1.10 to $2.67 since early Saturday, with 24-hour trading 3.4 times its market value. Only 13% of its supply circulates, and it is still 80% below its 2025 record.

item.title: Aster (ASTER) jumped 25% in 55 minutes on Sunday, then lost all of it in 15
item.description: ASTER rose from about $0.551 to $0.691 between 3:15 and 4:10 p.m. ET on November 15, then fell to $0.503 by 4:25 p.m. ET. It is now 79% below its record.

item.title: Bitway (BTW) falls another 27% in a day and is now 81% below its October record
item.description: BTW slid from about $0.72 to a low near $0.50 in 24 hours, its second steep daily drop this week, on only about $9.3 million of trading.

item.title: Meme coin Macca the Gator is up 272% in a day, and all of its trading runs through one Uniswap pool
item.description: MACCA, an Ethereum meme token whose CoinGecko price history starts at 2 p.m. ET on November 14, rose from about $0.0046 to a record $0.0190 on Sunday. It is on CoinGecko's trending list.

item.title: Meme coin AudaCity jumped 260% in 90 minutes after an 85% slide, and it trades in one Uniswap pool
item.description: AudaCity (DACITYCOIN), a five-day-old Ethereum meme token, crashed 85% from its record over two days, then rose from $0.0042 to $0.0152 in 90 minutes on Saturday afternoon, November 14. It is up 248% in 24 hours and No. 2 on CoinGecko's trending list.

item.title: Meme coin Gato The Cat jumped 39% in a day and tops CoinGecko's trending list, all in one Uniswap pool
item.description: GATO, a cat-themed Ethereum token whose CoinGecko price history starts on Saturday, November 14, rose 39% in 24 hours to Sunday, November 15, while bitcoin fell 1.8%. Every trade CoinGecko tracks ran through a single Uniswap pool.

item.title: Meme coin Identity.md jumped 43% in a day as bitcoin fell, all through one Uniswap pool
item.description: IMD, an Ethereum meme token with about one day of price history on CoinGecko, rose from about $0.0111 to $0.0159 in 24 hours to Sunday, November 15, and is No. 1 on CoinGecko's trending list. Bitcoin fell 2.0% over the same day.

item.title: Bitcoin has never lost two years in a row. It needs a 34% jump in 46 days to avoid it
item.description: Bitcoin closed 2025 at $87,509 on CoinMarketCap, down 6.3% for the year. At about $65,500 on Sunday, November 15, 2026, it is down 25% in 2026. CoinMarketCap's daily record since 2013 shows every losing year followed by a gain.

item.title: Polkadot, Filecoin, Algorand and Pi all hit record lows in one Saturday evening
item.description: As bitcoin slid on Saturday, November 14, 2026, Polkadot's DOT, Filecoin's FIL, Algorand's ALGO and Pi Network's PI all set all-time lows on CoinGecko within about three and a half hours. Each is now 97% to 99.7% below its peak.

item.title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin broke its 200-week average, but not for the first time
item.description: After bitcoin's weekend slide, posts claimed a first-ever break of the 200-week average, a record fear reading and an 18% loss for Strategy. We checked five claims against CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko and Strategy's own filing.

item.title: Solana fell 19% in a week. Shorts now pay on 83% of its $4.2 billion in futures bets
item.description: Funding on Solana perpetual futures was negative on almost every big venue, CoinGecko's derivatives data show. XRP looks similar. Bitcoin does not, and on Hyperliquid, Solana longs still pay.

item.title: SEC lets Nasdaq ISE list crypto ETF options without a vote per fund, if coins pass a $700 million test
item.description: A November 10 SEC order lets the options exchange list contracts on trusts that hold "digital commodities" without a new SEC vote for each fund. Each coin inside must pass a size test, and most of the fund a surveillance test.

item.title: Seven big dollar tokens shrank $3.46 billion in under a week. Only RLUSD grew
item.description: USDT and USDC lost $2.82 billion between them since Sunday, November 8, CoinGecko data show, as bitcoin fell 13.6% in seven days. Ripple's RLUSD added $107 million.

item.title: Gold token PAXG is 32% off its January record, yet holders added 16,200 ounces since August
item.description: PAX Gold fell 5.7% in a week to $3,826, CoinGecko data show. Its supply, one token per ounce, rose to 447,522 ounces, up 16,209 since its August 29 low.

item.title: Paxos's Global Dollar shrank $512 million in 24 days, 16% of its supply
item.description: USDG fell from $3.16 billion on October 22 to $2.65 billion on Sunday, CoinGecko data show. That is 25% below its May peak, while its price held at $1.

item.title: Sharks sold $47.6 million of dollar tokens in a day and bought $40.4 million
item.description: DeepSea's 24-hour shark lists show 18 stablecoin and dollar-yield token rows in 492 trades. That is a net $7.28 million out, led by Aave USDC on Arbitrum and AUSD on Monad.

item.title: Two traders made $147.7 million in crash week. Their Arbitrum wallets moved $55 million in a day
item.description: DeepSea's smart money board shows SMc060 up $80.36 million and SM6e36 up $67.36 million in 7 days. On Arbitrum, the same addresses sold $30 million and bought $25 million of tokens in a day, sums that match Aave's USDC deposit token.

item.title: Binance's Anthropic pre-IPO contract assumed 1 billion shares. The filing points to 13.1 billion
item.description: Binance priced its ANTHROPICUSDT contract on an estimate of 1 billion Anthropic shares. Citing Anthropic's latest IPO filing, it now expects about 13.1 billion and will resize and rename the contract before the stock lists.

item.title: Binance reopens withdrawals on 87 more networks after covering its $6.34 billion hack
item.description: Two weeks after the October 29 theft, Binance says it has covered every affected asset with company money and reopened withdrawals on 87 more networks, from Avalanche to Cardano. It aims to reopen the rest by the end of next week.

item.title: U.S. bitcoin ETFs lost $881 million in a week and $1.72 billion in seven straight days
item.description: U.S. spot bitcoin funds had net outflows every trading day from November 5 to 13 while bitcoin fell 8.6% over the week. Ether funds ended a six-day losing run with a $2.3 million inflow on Friday.

item.title: Ether fell to $1,714 on Saturday, below $1,800 for the first time since July
item.description: Ether fell below $1,900 late Friday and $1,800 on Saturday afternoon, then hit $1,714.75 at 8:45 p.m. ET, CoinGecko data show. That is its lowest price since early July, and ether has lost 18.9% in a week.

item.title: Rumor vs record: bitcoin hit $62,081, and only 3 of 7 viral crash claims hold up
item.description: Bitcoin's Saturday slide set off a wave of posts about record ETF exits, a 50% crash and a hidden fund blowup. We checked seven of the most shared claims against CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap and ETF flow data.

item.title: Hyperliquid passes Bybit to rank third in open bets, even as its crypto bets shrank 14%
item.description: Hyperliquid now ranks third for open futures bets, even though bets on its crypto markets fell about $590 million from Friday to early Sunday as bitcoin slid to $64,800. Bets on stocks, indexes and commodities held near $2.16 billion, CoinGecko data show.

item.title: Uniswap's UNI lost 29% in a week. DEX tokens fell 9.9% in a day, three times bitcoin's drop
item.description: Tokens of automated market makers, the pool-based exchanges behind most DeFi trading, lost 9.9% of their value in 24 hours to early Sunday. Bitcoin fell 3%. CoinGecko data show UNI, Curve and Aerodrome leading the slide.

item.title: One Arbitrum wallet sent out $36.4 million of EVA in a day, but DEXes traded just $80,000
item.description: DeepSea's 24-hour feed shows one unlabeled wallet sending out about 1 million EverValueCoin in 11 moves. The token's DEX pools could never have absorbed that as a sale.

item.title: OP fell 9.6% in a day. Optimism sharks still bought $2.58 million and sold $2.38 million
item.description: Big wallets on OP Mainnet ended the day as small net buyers of OP and WLD while both tokens slid. Most of them are still losing money this week.

item.title: 98 sharks lost $15.7 million in a week. Two BNB Chain wallets lost $5.3 million of it
item.description: Only 27 of 98 big wallets in DeepSea's live feed closed the week with a profit, and the winners made just $101,900 together. BNB Chain and Ethereum took the worst hits.

item.title: Uniswap's UNI falls 16% in a day to $4.77 as bitcoin drops 8% to its lowest since July
item.description: UNI slid from about $5.70 to $4.77 between Friday and Saturday evening, its lowest level since late August, and is down 33% in a week. Bitcoin fell from about $68,240 to $62,720 and ether lost about 10% over the same 24 hours.

item.title: Aster's ASTER drops 21% in 80 minutes to $0.48 while bitcoin slips about 2%
item.description: ASTER drifted near $0.62 for most of Saturday, then fell from about $0.61 at 2:35 p.m. ET to a low near $0.483 at 3:55 p.m. ET on November 14. Trading volume more than doubled and the token jumped onto CoinGecko's trending list.

item.title: Kava's KAVA falls 47% in two hours to a record low near $0.036
item.description: KAVA sat flat near $0.068 for two days, then broke down at 5:05 a.m. ET on November 14 and hit an all-time low of about $0.0356 before 7 a.m. ET. Prices on Korea's Upbit and Bithumb stayed far above the rest of the market.

item.title: A $128.7 million wallet sold $677,000 of ASTER and bought $991,000 of USDT0 as bitcoin slid
item.description: The address has no public label on DeepSea. DeepSea saw it trade on four networks in a day, cut ASTER and ARB, and win 28% of its trades in 30 days.

item.title: USDT0 added $115 million in a day, most since May. Sharks bought $2.57 million on Optimism
item.description: Tether's cross-chain token grew while USDT shrank, CoinGecko data show. DeepSea's data show large wallets swapping into it on Optimism and Berachain, and out of it on Unichain.

item.title: Ripple's RLUSD hit $2.79 billion, its highest in a year, up $83 million in a day. USDT shrank $323 million
item.description: While bitcoin slid and the biggest stablecoin lost supply, Ripple's dollar token kept growing, CoinGecko data show. DefiLlama counts a much smaller total.

item.title: Falcon's USDf shrank $104 million in a day, its biggest one-day drop since at least May
item.description: The synthetic dollar lost 5.7% of its market value in 24 hours as bitcoin slid, CoinGecko data show. It still trades just under $1, as it has for months.

item.title: A Monad wallet bought $1 million of MetaMask's mUSD in an hour and traded $167 million in 30 days
item.description: DeepSea counts 13,802 mUSD trades by one Monad shark in a month, more mUSD bought than DefiLlama counts on all of Monad. Who runs it is unknown.

item.title: Rumor vs record: XRP fell below $1. 3 of 7 viral claims hold up, 3 cannot be checked
item.description: XRP slipped under $1 late Friday and posts about it spread fast. We checked seven of the most shared claims against CoinGecko's price record. Three are true, one is partly true and three cannot be checked.

item.title: CFTC sued Arkansas and Louisiana in one day. Arkansas seeks up to $10,000 per Kalshi violation
item.description: On November 13, 2026, the U.S. derivatives regulator said it had sued Arkansas and Louisiana to stop state actions against federally regulated prediction markets. Arkansas is the 11th state it has taken to court.

item.title: Bitcoin hit $66,492, its lowest since August 19. Solana and HYPE fell twice as fast
item.description: Bitcoin set a new low for this slide overnight, $1,430 under the low in our Friday report, and is down 11.5% in a week, CoinGecko data show. Solana, Hyperliquid's HYPE and ether all fell to levels last seen in mid-August, and XRP slipped below $1.

item.title: Pearl rose 18% in a day while bitcoin slipped. It is still 37% below its October record
item.description: The token of Pearl, a blockchain that pays GPU miners for AI math, climbed from about $1.31 to $1.55 in 24 hours to Saturday, November 14, and is on CoinGecko's trending list. Bitcoin fell 1.6% over the same day.

item.title: AKE rose 82% more after our Friday report as $583 million traded, twice its value
item.description: Akedo's AKE token rose another 82% from Friday morning to early Saturday and is up almost fourfold from its 24-hour low, CoinGecko data show. It is still 92% below its September record.

item.title: One wallet took in $32.8 million of ARB in a week as ARB fell 14.5%. DeepSea shows $0 sent
item.description: A large Arbitrum wallet kept receiving ARB from four addresses and bought more, DeepSea's data show, through one of the token's weakest weeks. Who owns it is unknown, and we could not check it on a block explorer.
